title: Ads-B Web3
tagline: Ads-B Web3 is a decentralized flight tracking and airport information system that operates on the Web3 blockchain. It enables users to track flights and access real-time information about airports without relying on a centralized authority.
description:
ADS-B WEB3 is a decentralized flight tracking software that provides real-time flight tracking and live fleet tracking of airlines using RTL-SDR hardware and dump1090. The software utilizes its own ADS-B Web3 software to feed data to a decentralized polybase database, ensuring that the data is distributed across the network and more secure. One of the key features of ADS-B WEB3 is its carbon emissions calculator, which allows users to compare the carbon footprint of different modes of transport. The software also provides airport flight information such as departures and arrivals, making it an indispensable tool for travelers. In addition, ADS-B WEB3 allows airport schedule data entry and offers flight cancellation or delay insurance, which provides users with greater peace of mind when booking flights.

The insurance feature is a P2P insurance platform powered by the UMA Optimistic Oracle V3, which allows anyone to purchase or offer insurance for sale. This unique feature allows individuals to create and sell their own insurance policies, which are then backed by reliable and transparent market data. The UMA Optimistic Oracle V3 ensures that the insurance policies are accurately processed, reducing the risk of fraud. This makes ADS-B WEB3's insurance feature a reliable and affordable option for travelers who want to protect themselves against flight cancellations or delays. With ADS-B WEB3, users can track flights in real-time, access airport information, compare carbon emissions, and purchase or offer flight cancellation or delay insurance, all in one easy-to-use platform.
how_its_made:
ADS-B WEB3 is a decentralized flight tracking software that is cross-chain and works on multiple networks, including Gnosis Chiado, Optimism Goerli, Polygon ZkEVM, Scroll Network, Filecoin EVM, and Goerli. The software was built using next js and tailwindcss, two modern web development technologies that ensure a responsive and user-friendly interface. The data is provided by openskynetworks and ADS-B WEB3's own network of ADS-B data feeders, which are responsible for collecting and transmitting the aircraft data to the decentralized polybase database.

There are two types of ADS-B WEB3 feeders: the open to anyone version and the verified feeder. The verified feeder is powered by Optimism attestations to verify the authenticity of the feeders. When the verified feed link is selected as the data source for live tracking or fleet tracking, only verified data will be displayed. The feeders use a script to connect to dump1090, which is a software-defined radio decoder for Mode S and ADS-B signals.

ADS-B (Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast) is a surveillance technology used in aviation that enables aircraft to transmit their identity, position, altitude, and velocity to ground stations and other aircraft. RTL-SDR radio is a low-cost software-defined radio that can be used to capture the ADS-B data emitted by aircraft. This technology enables ADS-B WEB3 to collect real-time data on the location and movement of aircraft, which is then used to provide accurate flight tracking and airport information.

The carbon tracker feature in ADS-B WEB3 uses APIs from climatiq.io to provide users with the carbon footprint of different modes of transport. This feature allows users to compare the carbon emissions of different travel options, making it easier for them to make informed decisions about their transportation choices. Overall, ADS-B WEB3 is a powerful and versatile flight tracking software that utilizes cutting-edge technologies to provide users with real-time flight tracking, airport information, and carbon footprint calculations.
